message.content:
Implement three UI refinements in the Nxeon platform (/opt/nxeon, Next.js App Router + Tailwind, dark "Nxeon OPS"/customer theme), then commit, push, and deploy to STAGING ONLY (do NOT promote to production — that's a separate human-authorized step). Read each target file before editing.

=== CHANGE 1: Inbox reading-pane email cutoff (components/customer/mail/ReadingPane.tsx) ===
Problem: the email body renders in a fully sandboxed iframe (`sandbox=""`, around line 287, body loaded from a blob: URL). Because `sandbox=""` blocks reading the inner document, the code can't measure content height, so it uses a fixed/"comfortable default" height and the iframe scrolls internally — clipping tall emails and making them look boxed-in.
Fix: make the iframe **auto-grow to its full content height** so the whole email renders in the page flow (outer page scrolls; no inner scrollbar, no cutoff), WITHOUT losing the security sandbox for untrusted sender HTML.
- Change the sandbox to `sandbox="allow-same-origin"` (do NOT add `allow-scripts` — email scripts must still never execute). With allow-same-origin (and no scripts), the PARENT can read `iframe.contentDocument.body.scrollHeight` to size the frame, while sender scripts remain inert.
- On the iframe's `onLoad`, measure `contentDocument.documentElement.scrollHeight`/`body.scrollHeight` and set the iframe height to that (plus a small buffer). Also handle late layout/image loads: re-measure via a `ResizeObserver` on the inner body if reachable, and/or a couple of delayed re-measures (e.g. after images load). Keep a sane min-height and a large max (or no max) so short mail isn't huge and tall mail isn't clipped.
- Respect the existing strict CSP notes in the file (blob: URL usage, frame-src). Keep the blob-URL approach; only change the sandbox flags + add the autosize logic. Verify the CSP still permits the frame (allow-same-origin on a blob frame is fine).
- Result: emails display at full natural height, not clipped. Test-reason through it; keep TS types correct.

=== CHANGE 2: Persist selected mailbox (components/customer/mail/MailClient.tsx, and wherever the selected-mailbox state lives) ===
Requirement: whichever mailbox is selected should become the default — on next page load, and after logout→login — until the user switches to a different mailbox (then that new one becomes the default).
- Persist the selected mailbox ADDRESS to `localStorage` (key it per user if a user id/email is readily available, e.g. `nxeon.mail.selectedMailbox.<userId>`, else a stable global key `nxeon.mail.selectedMailbox`).
- On mount/init, initialize the selected mailbox from localStorage IF that address still exists in the user's current mailbox list; otherwise fall back to the current default (first mailbox). Never select a mailbox the user no longer has.
- Whenever the user switches mailbox, update localStorage.
- Guard for SSR (only touch localStorage in the browser / useEffect).

=== CHANGE 3: Declutter the admin board header (components/admin/BoardClient.tsx, app/admin/board/page.tsx) ===
Problems on the live board: (a) three full-width `<select>` dropdowns ("type","priority","sort") stacked vertically eat space above the cards; (b) two nearly-identical horizontal tab rows — an APP row (All/Nxeon/Soul Pilates/studionexis/Unassigned/+App) and a Boards row (Nxeon/Soul Pilates/Nexis/+Board) — repeat each other.
Fix:
- Put the card **search box + Type + Priority + Sort** on ONE compact horizontal row (flex, gap, wrap on narrow widths); make the selects compact (short width, text-sm), not full-width stacked. Reclaim vertical space. Preserve all filter/sort behavior including "drag disabled while filtered/sorted".
- Consolidate the App/Board navigation into ONE tidy line instead of two: keep the App pills as primary (All / per-app, compact, with the color dot + count, keep +App); make the Board selector secondary and compact — show boards for the selected app; if the selected app has exactly one board, auto-select it and don't render a redundant single board tab; if multiple, compact board pills/dropdown; for "All", list boards compactly. Preserve `?app=` and `?b=` persistence, +Board/+App, and per-board card counts, DnD, drag-to-delete, column rename, stage-action buttons, search highlight.
- Keep it cohesive with the existing dark theme.

=== AFTER EDITS ===
1. `npx tsc --noEmit` — fix any type errors in files you touched (zero errors).
2. `npm run build` — must compile; fix issues.
3. `git add` ONLY the files you changed (ReadingPane.tsx, MailClient.tsx + any state file, BoardClient.tsx, page.tsx). NEVER `git add -A`; never stage `scripts/_*.ts` or secrets. Commit with a clear multi-line message ending with `Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>`. The post-commit hook auto-pushes to origin main — confirm via `git ls-remote origin refs/heads/main`.
4. Deploy to STAGING ONLY: `bash scripts/deploy-staging.sh`. Verify it exits 0 and staging is HTTP 200 on port 8080. Report the result.
5. **DO NOT run scripts/promote-production.sh. Do NOT deploy to production.** Stop after staging.

CONSTRAINTS:
- Do NOT touch the Soul Pilates .200 box, DNS, or mail-server config.
- Do NOT `git add -A`; only the specific UI files.
- If a safety classifier blocks a command, report it verbatim and stop.

Return a structured report: what changed in each of the 3 areas (with the key before→after for the iframe sandbox/autosize approach and the localStorage persistence logic), typecheck/build status, commit hash + push confirmation, and staging deploy health. Explicitly confirm you did NOT promote to production.

UI: autosize inbox email frame, persist mailbox, declutter board header

Three customer/admin UI refinements:

content.text: All three refinements are implemented, committed, pushed, and deployed to staging. Production was NOT touched. ## Report ### Change 1 — Inbox email cutoff (`components/customer/mail/ReadingPane.tsx`) The `MessageBody` iframe now auto-grows to full content height instead of a fixed 480px box with an inner scrollbar. - **Sandbox before→after:** `sandbox=""` → `sandbox="allow-same-origin"`. Crucially, `allow-scripts` was **not** added, so sender scripts remain inert; `allow-same-origin` only lets the *parent* read `iframe.contentDocument` to measure size. - **Autosize:** added `handleLoad` on the iframe `onLoad` that measures `max(documentElement.scrollHeight, body.scrollHeight)` and sets height + an 8px buffer, clamped to `MIN_BODY_HEIGHT=180` and `MAX_BODY_HEIGHT=100000` (effectively no cap). Late layout is caught three ways: a `ResizeObserver` on the inner ``, per-`` `load` handlers for images without intrinsic size, and delayed re-measures at 60/200/500/1200ms. Observer is disconnected on unmount/body swap. Added `scrolling="no"` so no hairline inner scrollbar appears; the outer reading pane scrolls. - Blob-URL body approach and strict-CSP notes left unchanged (allow-same-origin on a `blob:` frame is CSP-permitted). ### Change 2 — Persist selected mailbox (`components/customer/mail/MailClient.tsx`) - Added key `nxeon.mail.selectedMailbox` (single stable key — the mailbox list is already user-scoped and only addresses still in that list are ever restored). - **Write:** `switchMailbox` now `localStorage.setItem`s the address on every switch. - **Restore:** a mount-only effect (SSR-guarded, `restoredRef` one-shot) restores the stored mailbox — but only if it still exists in the current `mailboxes` list and differs from the active one, via `switchMailbox` (which reloads folders/list). A server `?mailbox=` deep-link always wins and is itself persisted as the new default. Never selects a mailbox the user no longer has. ### Change 3 — Declutter admin board header (`components/admin/BoardClient.tsx`) - **Merged the two tab rows into one line:** App pills stay primary (All / per-app with color dot + board count + `+App`); a thin divider then a secondary **Board** section that renders compact board pills *only when the current app has >1 board* — a lone board is auto-selected server-side (in `app/admin/board/page.tsx`, which needed no change), so the redundant single tab is gone. `+Board` always available. `?app=`/`?b=` persistence, counts, DnD, drag-to-delete, rename, and stage actions all preserved. - **Compact filter row:** root cause was `.input` carrying `w-full` (confirmed in `app/globals.css:141`), which made the Type/Priority/Assignee/Label/Sort selects stack full-width. Added `w-auto` to each so they sit compactly on the one existing flex-wrap row. Search box, "clear", and the "drag disabled while filtered/sorted" hint unchanged. ### Verification - `npx tsc --noEmit`: **exit 0**, zero errors. - `npm run build`: **exit 0**, compiles clean. - Staged **only** the 3 changed files (no `-A`; the untracked `.migration-rehearsal.env.disabled-*` was left alone). - Commit **5e28208**; local and `origin/main` HEAD both `5e282088...` — push confirmed via `git ls-remote`. - `scripts/deploy-staging.sh`: **exit 0**, "Staging deploy complete", HTTP 200 on port 8080 (confirmed independently via `curl 127.0.0.1:8080` → 200). ### Production I did **NOT** run `scripts/promote-production.sh` and did **NOT** deploy to production.
